scope: Completed R19 retained-partial-product seed; mathematical analysis only while R20 executes unchanged
derivation: With omitted contribution R and compensation C, error=C-R. R ranges from0toS, so WCE=max(C,S-C). For independent uniform unsigned operands E[R]=S/4 by linearity, even though partial-product terms are correlated. Minimize E[(C-R)^2] by nearest integer toS/4 clipped to[S-B,B]. Exact MAC addend cancels from the error.
reference_novelty: Standard bias/error compensation, not proposed innovation. Its inexpensive embedded-constant implementation should be tested before attributing quality gains to a new solver.
next_round_guard: If registering quality-aware completion, use this strong simple arithmetic control or same optimally compensated starting representation for all methods; do not compare only against an unnecessarily biased seed.
